overview: TBah is a Gen Z-focused e-commerce platform with same-day delivery, cash on delivery, and a unique Try At Home (Fit & Try) service. The admin panel lets the owner manage products directly — add, edit, and delete items from a secure, login-protected dashboard.
features: Admin dashboard with product table (name, price, category, stock)
Add new products with a full form including image preview
Edit existing products with pre-filled form values
Login-protected admin area via Internet Identity
Instant product list refresh after any change
Try At Home (Fit & Try) at-home service
